record.title: Banke restricts Nepali shopping trips through Jamunaha–Rupaidiha during the 2021 COVID wave
record.scope: Non-essential outbound travel by Nepali residents, especially shopping trips
record.direction: Nepal to India for the restricted trips
record.movement: Nepali residents making non-essential trips to the Indian border market; no total freight prohibition established.
record.exceptions: Essential work permitted in April account; India-to-Nepal returns subject to screening.
record.imposing_authority: Banke district administration and district COVID crisis/risk-management authorities
record.enforcement: Officials reported a prohibition and police directions at the border; July 29 RSS reporting already describes resumed shopping, with August field reporting documenting informal easing.
record.relationship: Local renewed restriction within Nepal’s broader pandemic regime SA021, after January 2021 formal easing. Not an additional independent national shutdown.
record.status_observation: Restriction reported by March 25 and again April 16; daily shopping observed by August 21, 2021, without a first reopening date.
record.official_rationale: District officials sought to limit imported COVID infections.
record.context: Selective local enforcement during the renewed wave.
record.uncertainty: The initial decision date and interruptions before April remain unknown. March 25 is an observation, not onset. Shopping was occurring by July 29, 2021, but the first relaxation day is unknown. Formal national restrictions and local practice differed.

historical.duration_note: Not eligible for a single continuous-duration calculation; see movement scope, phases and uncertainty. No measured continuous interval is established.
